rows.ja: 親会社・電力の調達先
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 子会社AMCを通じて株式の88.9%を保有する親会社
relations.text_en: Parent that owns 88.9% through Americas Mining Corporation

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, Grupo Mexico, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Americas Mining Corporation ("AMC"), owned 88.9% of our capital stock.

companies.name: メキシコ・ヘネラドーラ・デ・エネルヒア(MGE)

relations.text: メキシコ事業の電力の大半を買うグルポ・メヒコ傘下の発電会社
relations.text_en: Grupo Mexico power producer that supplies most of its Mexican electricity

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We purchase most of our electricity from Mexico Generadora de Energia S. de R. L. ("MGE"), a subsidiary of Grupo Mexico which has two power plants designed to supply power to La Caridad and Buenavista units.

relations.text: ペルー事業に120MWを20年間供給する電力購入契約
relations.text_en: 20-year, 120 MW power purchase agreement for its Peruvian operations

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In June 2014, we entered into a power purchase agreement for 120 megawatts ("MW") with the state owned company Electroperu S.A., which began supplying energy to our Peruvian operations for a twenty-year period that started on April 17, 2017.

companies.name: カルパ・ヘネラシオン

relations.text: ペルー事業に電力を供給する民間発電会社(120MW+最大80MW)
relations.text_en: Private generator supplying its Peruvian operations (120 MW plus up to 80 MW)

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In July 2014, we entered into a power purchase agreement for 120MW with a private power generator Kallpa Generacion S.A.

relations.text: グループ会社Asarcoから銅精鉱やカソードなどを購入し、加工委託料も支払う
relations.text_en: Buys copper concentrates, cathodes and other products from sister company Asarco and pays it tolling fees

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's Mexican operations purchased copper concentrates, starter sheets, cathodes, bars and a fixed asset from Asarco LLC and also paid fees for tolling services.

companies.name: メキシコ・コンパニア・コンストラクトーラ

relations.text: メキシコ事業の建設サービスを担うグルポ・メヒコ傘下の会社
relations.text_en: Grupo Mexico company providing construction services to its Mexican operations

source.label: Southern Copper 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company's Mexican operations paid fees for construction services provided by Mexico Compania Constructora S.A. de C.V.

relations.text: ペルーのコイモラチェ鉱山を共同保有し(サザン・コッパー44.244%)、探鉱でも組む
relations.text_en: Co-owns the Coimolache mine (Southern Copper 44.244%) and runs joint exploration

source.label: Buenaventura 20-F/A(2023年度)
source.quote: Currently, Cía. de Minas Buenaventura S.A.A. (BVN) holds 40.09% of the shares, 44.244% is held by Southern Copper Corporation (SPCC) and 15.662% is held by ESPRO S.A.C.

relations.text: BHPが20-Fで、銅の競合の一社としてSouthern Copperを挙げる
relations.text_en: BHP names Southern Copper among its copper competitors

source.label: BHP 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Competitors include: Anglo American, Antofagasta, Codelco, Freeport, Glencore, Rio Tinto, Southern Copper, Teck.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
